blurb: Guests explore a massive hillside corn maze, a 7-acre sunflower field, a pumpkin patch with a free pumpkin included, a petting zoo with various animals, a river walk, and enjoy live music and games. Hayrides to the pumpkin patch are included with admission. Optional extras include pony rides, sunflower jar picks, hot air balloon rides, and a pumpkin shop.
extraNote: Festival runs rain or shine; hot air balloon rides are weather-dependent · Online tickets are not date-specific; use any open day of the season · Re-entry allowed same day with wristband · Free parking on-site; staff assist with parking · Cash, card, and Apple Pay accepted for admission and extras · Season passes are non-transferable; named adult must be present at entry · September 18 – November 1, 2026 Fridays, Saturdays & Sundays
